title: pm-dispatch SKILL: require a four-lens analysis block on every needs-user-decision card
body:
Maintainer accepted 2026-08-11: decision cards reach the maintainer pre-analyzed on four fixed lenses, so rulings do not depend on a seat back-filling the analysis later.

The change (SKILL edit, by PR, mind the line ratchet): the step-0 / step-8 guidance for `needs-user-decision` gains a required short block — one line per lens:

1. **Platform long-term coherence** — does each option shrink or grow special cases / contract accretion?
2. **Measured business pull** — who hits this today; zero-pull options default to defer/remove.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance** — which option is hardest for an AI author/consumer to misuse (closed enums over structured reads, loud refusal over silent tolerance, no fabricated success)?
4. **Startup scope discipline** — prefer remove over declare-and-maintain; every declared key is a permanent obligation.

Evidence this pays for itself: the 2026-08-11 four-lens re-review of the standing decision ledger reversed 4 of ~30 recommendations that a urgency-times-leverage framing had gotten wrong (recorded on #7485, #7243, objectui#4165, objectui#3804).

Filed by the triage seat Routine (#5474 pilot) recording a maintainer ruling of 2026-08-11. **Unassigned — recording, not claiming.**
